features.name: Noguchi Playscape
features.description: Noguchi Playscape is a visitor destination identified by Piedmont Park Conservancy within Piedmont Park.

details.imageAlt: Cylindrical spiral slide, one of the sculptural play elements of the Noguchi Playscape in Piedmont Park , Atlanta. Designed by Japanese-American artist Isamu Noguchi , the playground was commissioned by the High Museum of Art and gifted to the City of Atlanta in 1976. It was Noguchi’s only realized playscape design during his lifetime and was fully restored in 2005 after years of disrepair. Midtown’s Bank of America Plaza —the tallest building in the Southeast—rises in the background.
